_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#13. The rule holds for MONOLITHIC FSI and the quoted Signal is fabricated. Upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml (COUPALGO iter_monolithicfluidsplit) exits 0 with 6 result tests CORRECT. Prepending IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT + IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE makes it exit 1 with 'Runtime output is not available in the old structure time integration! You need to take the new one, i.e. set `INT_STRATEGY: Standard`!' from src/structure/4C_structure_timint.cpp line 262, and zero .vtu written. That advice is a dead end: INT_STRATEGY already defaults to Standard, and writing it explicitly into STRUCTURAL DYNAMIC produces the identical abort (MONOSTD_SAME_ABORT=1, MONOSTD_VTU=0), because FSI::MonolithicBase::create_structure_time_integrator constructs the deprecated Adapter::StructureBaseAlgorithm unconditionally. The catalogue's 'inconsistent integration strategy' appears nowhere (CLAIMED_INCONSISTENT_INT_STRATEGY_TEXT=0). The rule is also narrower than the entry says: PARTITIONED FSI is unaffected — the identical two sections on upstream volmortar2D_fsi.4C.yaml (COUPALGO iter_stagg_*) exit 0 with 6 tests CORRECT and do write .vtu. So it is monolithic FSI that has to fall back to post_vtu, not FSI in general. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Runtime output is not available in the old structure time integration! You need to take the new one, i.e. set `INT_STRATEGY: Standard`!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop asking monolithic FSI for runtime structural output. That arm reverts to the baseline, exits 0, and the abort message vanishes, so the fixture must go red.

remove the pathology from the partitioned control arm instead: without the VTK sections it writes no .vtu, PARTVTK_WROTE_VTU becomes no, and the fixture loses the evidence that the restriction is monolithic-only — so it must go red.
